verdict.rationale: Sardine documents ongoing monitoring that alerts you when an enrolled customer lands on a sanctions, PEP or adverse-media list (daily rescreening). It also offers a case-management workspace for reviewing alerts and explainable scores, so a new list hit is itself the visible change. However, no evidence shows a view that compares the customer's prior and current state or details what triggered a re-alert. Missing for 10: an explicit change or diff view between monitoring runs, documentation of what an alert detail page shows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
